# ScramServerNpc

*Server* · extends [`ScriptServerEntity`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerEntity)

Controls a Scram NPC from server scripts. Setters change the NPC's properties, as the NPC editor does: they apply at once, update the NPC for every player who sees it and are saved with the NPC. Trigger events are `"init"`, `"interact"`, `"hurt"`, `"attack"`, `"death"`, `"respawn"`,

`"tick"` and `"target"`; their triggers run with the NPC as the subject.

### walkTo {#walkto}

::: member

Makes the NPC walk to a position along a path. The patrol route and wandering wait until it arrives, loses the path or [`stopWalking()`](#stopwalking) is called; fighting interrupts the walk.

```js
var npc = c.getNpc();

if (!npc.walkTo(10, 64, 10)) {
    c.send("The NPC cannot get there");
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether a path was found

:::

### stopWalking {#stopwalking}

::: member

Stops a walk started with [`walkTo(double, double, double)`](#walkto); the patrol route or wandering continues.

:::

### addPatrolPoint {#addpatrolpoint}

::: member

Adds a point at the end of the patrol route; the NPC walks the route while it does not wander or fight.

```js
var npc = c.getNpc();

npc.addPatrolPoint(0, 64, 0);
npc.addPatrolPoint(10, 64, 0);
npc.setPatrolLooping(true);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

:::

### addPatrolPoint {#addpatrolpoint-2}

| Parameter | Type | Description |

| `position` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | block position; components are rounded down |

:::

### addScriptTrigger {#addscripttrigger}

Adds a trigger that runs a function of a server script on an NPC event.
